title: Uplift for a Vehicle with a Documented Care Plan Record
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing whose servicing is documented under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is adjusted upward. Two things are read off that plan: the completed visits in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date, and whether care credits are still standing on the plan.

1. A vehicle with three or more completed Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan visits in that window and care credits still standing on that plan is adjusted to 1.03 of the figure, one and three hundredths.

2. A vehicle with one or two completed care plan visits in that window, or with three or more and no care credit standing, is adjusted to 1.015 of the figure, one and fifteen thousandths.

3. A vehicle with no completed care plan visit in that window is carried at the figure unchanged, a share of 1.

### How the two readings combine

| Completed care plan visits in the window | Care credits standing | Share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | yes | 1.03 |
| 3 or more | none | 1.015 |
| 1 or 2 | yes or none | 1.015 |
| none | yes or none | 1 |

A vehicle with 4 completed visits and no care credit left falls on the second row, not the first: the top share needs both the visits and a credit still standing. A vehicle with no completed visit in the window is carried unchanged whatever credits stand on its plan, because the third clause turns on the visits alone.

*Worked on a hypothetical figure.* A figure of 40000.00 USD adjusted at 1.03 gives 41200.00 USD; the same figure adjusted at 1.015 gives 40600.00 USD.
